paragraphs: Ferrara Fire Apparatus manufactures custom, heavy-duty fire trucks. Its line covers pumpers, aerials, industrial, wildland, and rescue apparatus. The company works hands-on with municipal and industrial fire departments.

It offers a custom chassis line that it says has exceeded all safety and strength tests. Those chassis use Domex steel frame rails, with optional full-length liners. They are combined with extruded aluminum fire bodies. Welds are made with a root pass and two filler passes rather than tack welds.

Ferrara describes itself as the only apparatus manufacturer using marine-grade aluminum. Trucks are built at the company facility in Holden, Louisiana. The company states that over 6,000 of its fire trucks have been delivered around the world. It also points to more than 30 years of work in the Louisiana oil and gas region behind its industrial pump expertise. Many of its team members serve as volunteer firefighters.

quote.text: FERRARA FIRE APPARATUS MANUFACTURES CUSTOM, HEAVY-DUTY FIRE TRUCKS.
